notes:
Venture 0.27 — Wi-Fi networks and battery

• The controller now remembers the Wi-Fi networks it has joined. Saved networks are marked on the Wi-Fi page and reconnect with a single tap, without typing the password again. You are only asked for it if the saved one stops working.

• Saved networks that are out of range are listed too, and each saved network has a FORGET button (tap twice to confirm).

• If a network cannot be joined, the controller goes straight back to the network it was on.

• The controller's battery level is shown as a percentage inside the battery outline in the top-right corner. It turns green while charging, amber at 30% and red at 15%.

Installing over the top keeps your missions and settings.
